x: Paul Roche now urgently knocked on the door of a nearby house and persuaded the occupants that the twelve men jogging up and down in the front garden were not escaped lunatics but really did want to dial "999".

Further back in the pack Paul Roche showed promise of good things to come, only six months after joining the Club. Howard Satchell continued his come-back of all come-backs and a hirsute John Dudman seemed to have lost little of his form after taking time off to visit Australia.

New Zealander Mike Riley ran to an impressive 55:55, just ahead of Stuart Masterson (limbering up for the following week's Unigate Marathon) and Paul Roche in his first '10' got the best of Brian Gorman, much to the latter's chagrin.

Simon Williamson, one of our younger runners, did extraordinarily well to place 65th with Paul Roche only two seconds behind him. Another of our juniors coming through nicely now is Peter Gardner whose eye opening 81st nearly caught B.

Reseve Paul Roche brought us to the half-way point and at this stage Invicta AC were making a strong challenge, leading from Thames Valley with Cambridge H, Portsmouth (Martin Hyman) and Brighton not far behind.
Top left: Lionel Mann leads the main bunch - Brian Gorman, Paul Roche, Leo Coy and Jamie Stevenson. Top centre: Charlie Manning attempts to hold on to Martin Best.

Colin Pearson, in dogging these two's footsteps early on, seemed to have the third spot sewn up but from about seven miles Bill Weller and then Leo Coy and Paul Roche seemed to be making ground on him.

It was good to see John Jackson returning to form after his injury and Paul Roche exchanging a rugby shirt for a singlet. Even our new track captain emerged from hibernation but fell asleep halfway round to finish back in the second half of the field - he must have mistimed his final burst.

Also very successful were Ross Martin, and the Richleys.(It's always the same people isn't it).Sponsership from the London Marathon also went very well with Bill Couzens raising over £300 and Paul Roche raising over £150.
